A bright and elegant countryside-style home with a clean and cozy atmosphere. The living room features a beige linen sofa with walnut wood legs, accompanied by a soft cream-colored knitted throw blanket and pastel-toned cushions. A light oak coffee table with rounded edges sits atop a woven jute rug with subtle geometric patterns. The dining area showcases a solid wood table paired with upholstered chairs in muted sage green. White sheer curtains allow natural light to flood in, complementing the light beige walls.
